name: openspective
description: OpenSpective — AI-Powered OSINT, Public Intelligence & Passive Reconnaissance Platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/worker
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply openspective-db --local --config apps/worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply openspective-db --remote --config apps/worker/wrangler.toml
